description: This file implements a dynamic string vector data structure with functions for initialization, insertion, deletion, splicing, and splitting strings.

methods.name: strvec_init
methods.description: Initializes a strvec structure to an empty state.

methods.name: strvec_push_nodup
methods.description: Pushes a string into the vector without duplicating it.

methods.name: strvec_push
methods.description: Pushes a copy of a string into the vector.

methods.name: strvec_pushf
methods.description: Pushes a formatted string into the vector.

methods.name: strvec_pushl
methods.description: Pushes multiple strings into the vector from variadic arguments.

methods.name: strvec_pushv
methods.description: Pushes an array of strings into the vector.

methods.name: strvec_splice
methods.description: Replaces a range of elements with new strings.

methods.name: strvec_replace
methods.description: Replaces a specific element with a new string.

methods.name: strvec_remove
methods.description: Removes an element at a specified index.

methods.name: strvec_pop
methods.description: Removes the last element from the vector.

methods.name: strvec_split
methods.description: Splits a string into tokens and pushes them into the vector.

methods.name: strvec_clear
methods.description: Clears all elements from the vector.

methods.name: strvec_detach
methods.description: Detaches the internal array of strings from the vector.
